QuestInfo.name: A Nagging Doubt
QuestInfo.0: The Seal Stone and #p1404001# are both safe. Your idea of a damsel-in-distress went out the window when you met her. She's one tough cookie!
QuestInfo.1:
#p1404001# asked about something strange she noticed when researching the heroes of the past. #bShe thought it was weird that the heroes who saved Maple World were forgotten so completely.#k. 

It does seem odd. Board the #m150000000# and ask #p1401002# to collect information on the heroes of your time.
QuestInfo.2: You asked #p1401002# to study the heroes of the past. Prior to the alliance, how many people knew about the heroes?

1.0: Hey boss! Looks like #p1002104# sent word for you! What did you find out? Something juicy?\r\n#L0##b(You tell her everything you and #p1404001# talked about.)#l\n#k
1.1: #rChanging history#k?! That's a jackpot of trouble right there! Somebody's cooking up some nasty schemes... \r\n#L0##bSomeone has been tampering with the continent's history for hundreds of years, making the information work for their nefarious purposes. It's not a sure thing, but it's a terrifying thought.#l\n#k
1.2: I'll scour the continent for anything I can find about the old heroes. Records, historical data, artifacts... whatever. I'll get them.

yes.0: We might even be able to find somebody who witnessed it happening.

npc.0: Are you just hanging out in Rien? It's pretty nice here, but I thought you had stuff to do.
